{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# This preserves all patients in the treatment arm, even if they have biomarker_baseline == -999
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq, then drop duplicates
df_dedup = df.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Step 2: Filter to only the treatment arm
treatment_df = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Step 3: Compute the fraction of patients who responded
fraction_responded = treatment_df['responded'].mean()

# Print the required numbers
print(f'Number of unique patients after deduplication: {df_dedup.shape[0]}')
print(f'Number of patients in treatment arm: {treatment_df.shape[0]}')
print(f'Number of responders in treatment arm: {treatment_df["responded"].sum()}')
print(f'Fraction responded: {fraction_responded}')"}
